{{Quote|I'm surprised you haven't heard of him. He's head chef for one of the big luxury cruise lines that work the Inner Cluster.|[[Micah Giiett]], on [[Slabba Drewl]]|<ref name="JC">{{Tales|7|Jedi Chef}}</ref>}}
The '''Inner Cluster''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cona/Legends|Cona]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Teke Ro system]].<ref name="UAA" />
